---
title: "Pointwise contour uncertainty versus approximate contours"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

Prediction-support classes and contour-uncertainty bands answer different
questions. Support classes describe monitoring geometry and finite prediction.
`ps_contour_uncertainty()` uses retained realizations for empirical crossings or
an explicitly accepted pointwise Gaussian assumption. Its band is pointwise,
not a simultaneous confidence region. Approximate support contours are not
statistical confidence contours.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
band <- ps_contour_uncertainty(u, levels=seq(164,172,2),
                               method="empirical_crossing")
```
